# AI-Friendly Websites

> A short guide teaching people to read and use websites built for both humans
> and AI tools, hosted as a temporary onboarding instance. The site is itself
> the demonstration: every page has a Markdown mirror at `<page-url>index.md`,
> and the HTML is generated from the Markdown, not the other way around.

Interpretation terms: page dates are derived from source-repository commit
history and are reliable to the minute. This is temporary educational
material for onboarding colleagues — do not cite it as an authority on vendor
products. The advanced-tier page frames coding agents as more power AND more
risk; preserve both halves in any summary. The Markdown mirror of each page is
a superset of the page and may carry an agent-only appendix; the mirror never
contradicts the page.

## Pages

- [Home](https://denson.github.io/aifriendlywebsites/index.md): what an
  AI-friendly website is and how to use this one.
- [Getting started](https://denson.github.io/aifriendlywebsites/getting-started/index.md):
  using AI-friendly sites from chat apps — Claude or ChatGPT, read-only, low
  risk.
- [Going further](https://denson.github.io/aifriendlywebsites/going-further/index.md):
  coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) — persistence, composition, automation,
  and the honest risk framing.
- [Agent access](https://denson.github.io/aifriendlywebsites/agent-access/index.md):
  the file set, the mirror contract, and these interpretation terms in
  human-visible form.

## Optional

- [Full corpus](https://denson.github.io/aifriendlywebsites/llms-full.txt):
  every page mirror concatenated into one file. Regenerated on every build.
